info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Realestate Listings Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Status API enables users to retrieve the current status of real estate listings. This API serves as a crucial resource for real estate agents, property managers, and prospective buyers looking to stay updated on property availability and conditions. Key operations include fetching detailed information about listings, which helps consumers make informed decisions in a competitive market. Use cases may include integration into realty applications or creating dashboards that represent real estate trends.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of various listings. It's useful for checking availability, conditions, or any other relevant listing state information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of listings. It must be formatted as JSON and contain all necessary parameters to specify the desired listing statuses.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of listings.
